title: Gateway session state
responsibility: Defines gateway message types and creates the mutable state of a fresh gateway session.

inputs.name: gatewayTypes.id
inputs.description: The required session identifier used as the new session's id and copied unchanged into the returned GatewaySession. Its format is not validated by this function.

outputs.name: gatewayTypes
outputs.description: A fresh session state object containing the supplied id, a new AbortController, empty pending and replay Maps, an empty delivered Set, and running set to false. The optional emit callback is omitted, and the id is not validated.
